items.name: PDF Summarizer
items.description: PDF Summarizer & Chat
items.long_description:
Say goodbye to PDF anxiety. PDF Summarizer turns walls of text into quick, useful takeaways that stick. AI finds the gold in any document - key facts, main points, critical data - without the endless scrolling. Finish reading assignments in record time. Prep for big meetings during your commute. Make faster decisions with clearer information. Students, professionals, researchers: get hours back in your day. Reading, simplified.

Key Features:

Multi-File Chats
Add all your PDFs to one conversation and talk with them together. Ask questions across multiple documents without switching tabs. Perfect for research projects where you need to connect information from different sources.

Summarize PDFs
Get the main points from long documents in seconds. The system reads through your PDF and creates a clear overview of what matters. Skip hours of reading when you just need the key takeaways.

Any language
Turn any PDF into your preferred language instantly. A Spanish contract becomes English, a German research paper becomes French - whatever you need. Read foreign documents as easily as if they were written in your native language.

Side-by-Side View
See your document and chat in the same window. Questions you ask link directly to specific parts of your PDF. Check sources immediately and explore topics further without losing your place.
